يستحقا (form X)
# يَسْتَحِقَّا (yastaḥiqqā) /jas.ta.ħiq.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# يُسْتَحَقَّا (yustaḥaqqā) /jus.ta.ħaq.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
